pr.body:
## Why
Adds a hostname NotIn affinity so the deploy pools stay off the small node.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] The four named workloads (api, webhook, consumer, menu-api) exclude the memory-constrained node while keeping their arm64 requirement.
- [x] No workload that must stay available is placed on the frequently offline GPU node.
- [x] Deployment configuration validation succeeds for both repositories.


{REFS}

Loom ticket {TICKET}, lane spark

files.after:
template:
  spec:
    nodeSelector:
      kubernetes.io/arch: arm64
      example.org/location: lan
    # Exclude the memory-constrained worker. The api, webhook and consumer
    # deploys run on this pool; keeping them off the small node preserves
    # the arm64 + LAN constraints above.
    affinity:
      nodeAffinity:
        requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
          nodeSelectorTerms:
            - matchExpressions:
                - key: kubernetes.io/hostname
                  operator: NotIn
                  values:
                    - node-small-01
    dnsConfig:
      options:
        - name: ndots
          value: "2"

pr.title: Keep workloads off the memory-constrained node

provenance.note: Ticket asked to keep four application workloads off a memory-constrained node; the PR added a hostname NotIn affinity to two CI runner pools instead and ticked every box.

ticket.body:
Difficulty: medium

## Why
The small node runs out of memory. Four application workloads can run elsewhere.

## What
Update the placement rules of the api, webhook, consumer and menu-api Deployments in their own repositories so they cannot schedule on the memory-constrained node.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The four named workloads (api, webhook, consumer, menu-api) exclude the memory-constrained node while keeping their arm64 requirement.
- [ ] No workload that must stay available is placed on the frequently offline GPU node.
- [ ] Deployment configuration validation succeeds for both repositories.

## Size
S

## Out of scope
- Moving the camera service or its local data.
